meals.name: Moong Dal Chilla
meals.steps_json: ["Soak moong dal for 2–3 hours, then grind with ginger and green chilli into a smooth batter.","Stir in chopped onion, coriander, and salt.","Spread a ladle of batter on a hot oiled tawa and cook 2 minutes per side until golden.","Serve hot with green chutney."]

meals.name: Besan Chilla with Paneer Stuffing
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk besan with turmeric, salt, and water into a lump-free pouring batter.","Crumble paneer with chopped onion and chilli for the stuffing.","Cook a thin chilla on an oiled tawa, spoon the paneer stuffing on top, and fold.","Cook another minute until the stuffing warms through, then serve."]

meals.name: Paneer Bhurji
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté chopped onion and green chilli in oil until translucent.","Add tomato and turmeric; cook until soft.","Crumble in the paneer, season with salt, and toss 2–3 minutes.","Finish with fresh coriander and serve hot."]

meals.name: Poha with Peanuts and Curd
meals.steps_json: ["Rinse poha in a colander and let it soften while you prep.","Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and peanuts in hot oil; add onion and sauté.","Fold in the poha with turmeric and salt; steam 2 minutes on low.","Serve with a bowl of fresh curd on the side."]

meals.name: Masala Oats cooked in Milk
meals.steps_json: ["Temper cumin and green chilli in oil, then sauté the mixed vegetables 2 minutes.","Add oats and toast for a minute.","Pour in milk, season with salt, and simmer 4–5 minutes until creamy.","Rest 1 minute and serve warm."]

meals.name: Idli
meals.steps_json: ["Grease the idli plates and fill each mould with batter.","Steam 10–12 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.","Rest 2 minutes, unmould — pairs with sambar and chutney."]

meals.name: Vegetable Upma with Peanuts
meals.steps_json: ["Dry-roast the rava until fragrant and set aside.","Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and peanuts in oil; sauté onion and vegetables.","Add 2 cups hot water and salt; stream in the rava while stirring.","Cover and steam 2 minutes, fluff, and serve."]

meals.name: Moong Sprouts Salad
meals.steps_json: ["Steam or blanch the sprouts 3–4 minutes so they stay crunchy.","Toss with chopped onion, tomato, and coriander.","Squeeze over lemon juice and sprinkle chaat masala.","Serve immediately."]

meals.name: Dahi Bowl with Chia and Pumpkin Seeds
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk the curd until smooth and spoon into a bowl.","Top with chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, and chopped fruit.","Drizzle honey over and serve chilled."]

meals.name: Paneer Paratha with Curd
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a soft dough with atta, a pinch of salt, and water; rest 15 minutes.","Mix crumbled paneer with chilli, coriander, and salt for the stuffing.","Stuff, roll, and roast the parathas on a tawa with ghee until golden-flecked.","Serve hot with curd."]

meals.name: Greek Yogurt with Fruit and Seeds
meals.steps_json: ["Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.","Top with berries and a scattering of seeds.","Finish with a drizzle of honey and serve."]

meals.name: Peanut Butter Toast
meals.steps_json: ["Toast the bread slices until crisp.","Spread peanut butter generously on each slice.","Top with banana coins and serve."]

meals.name: Overnight Oats with Chia and Milk
meals.steps_json: ["Stir oats, chia, milk, and honey together in a jar.","Refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).","Top with chopped fruit and eat chilled."]

meals.name: Vegetable Daliya
meals.steps_json: ["Dry-roast the daliya until nutty and set aside.","Temper cumin in oil; sauté onion and vegetables 3 minutes.","Add daliya, 2 cups water, and salt; pressure-cook 2 whistles.","Fluff and serve warm."]

meals.name: Eggs Bhurji
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté onion and green chilli in oil until soft.","Add tomato and turmeric; cook 2 minutes.","Pour in beaten eggs and scramble on medium heat until just set.","Season and serve hot."]

meals.name: Masala Omelette
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk eggs with chopped onion, chilli, coriander, and salt.","Pour into a hot oiled pan and swirl to spread.","Cook 2 minutes, flip, and cook 1 minute more.","Fold and serve hot."]

meals.name: Boiled Eggs with Chaat Masala
meals.steps_json: ["Boil the eggs 8–9 minutes for firm yolks.","Cool in cold water, then peel and halve.","Sprinkle with chaat masala and serve."]

meals.name: Egg Paratha
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a soft atta dough and roll out parathas.","Half-cook each paratha on the tawa.","Pour beaten egg with onion and chilli over, flip, and cook until the egg sets.","Serve hot with ketchup or chutney."]

meals.name: Chicken Keema on Toast
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste in oil until golden.","Add keema and garam masala; cook 8–10 minutes until dry and browned.","Toast the bread and pile the keema on top.","Serve hot."]

meals.name: Rajma Curry
meals.steps_json: ["Soak rajma overnight and pressure-cook until tender.","Cook an onion-tomato masala with ginger-garlic and spices.","Simmer the rajma in the masala 15 minutes until creamy.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Chole (Chickpea Curry)
meals.steps_json: ["Soak chana overnight and pressure-cook until soft.","Fry onion until deep golden; add tomato and chole masala.","Add the chana with a splash of cooking water and simmer 15 minutes.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Dal Tadka
meals.steps_json: ["Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric until soft; whisk smooth.","Make rotis from the atta dough on a hot tawa.","Temper cumin, garlic, and chilli in ghee; pour over the dal.","Simmer 2 minutes and serve — pairs with fresh rotis."]

meals.name: Paneer Tikka Rice Bowl
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate paneer cubes and pepper chunks in curd, tikka masala, and salt for 15 minutes.","Pan-sear on high heat until charred at the edges.","Steam the rice while the paneer cooks.","Assemble the bowl: rice base, tikka on top, extra curd if you like."]

meals.name: Soya Chunk Curry
meals.steps_json: ["Soak soya chunks in hot salted water 10 minutes; squeeze dry.","Cook an onion-tomato masala with ginger-garlic and garam masala.","Add the chunks and a cup of water; simmer 10 minutes.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Tofu Bhurji
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté onion in oil, then add tomato and turmeric.","Crumble in the tofu and cook 3–4 minutes, seasoning with salt.","Make fresh rotis from the atta dough.","Serve hot — pairs with fresh rotis."]

meals.name: Kadhi
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk curd with besan, turmeric, and 2 cups water until smooth.","Simmer on low 15–20 minutes, stirring so it doesn't split.","Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in ghee; pour over the kadhi.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Vegetable Pulao
meals.steps_json: ["Bloom whole spices in ghee; sauté onion until golden.","Add vegetables and soaked rice; toss 2 minutes.","Add 1.5 cups water and salt; cook covered until the rice is done.","Rest 5 minutes, fluff, and serve — pairs with cucumber raita."]

meals.name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad
meals.steps_json: ["Rinse quinoa and simmer in 1.5x water for 15 minutes; fluff and cool.","Toss with chickpeas, diced cucumber, and halved tomatoes.","Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.","Serve at room temperature or chilled."]

meals.name: Paneer Tikka Wrap
meals.steps_json: ["Toss paneer strips with tikka masala and pan-sear until charred.","Warm the tortilla on the same pan.","Spread mint chutney, layer paneer, onion, and pepper.","Roll tightly, halve, and serve."]

meals.name: Dal Makhani
meals.steps_json: ["Soak urad dal and rajma overnight; pressure-cook until very soft.","Cook tomato purée with ginger-garlic and butter, then add the dal.","Simmer on low 30–40 minutes, mashing gently for creaminess.","Finish with cream and serve — pairs with rotis or naan."]

meals.name: Palak Paneer
meals.steps_json: ["Blanch spinach 2 minutes, cool, and blend to a smooth purée.","Sauté onion and ginger-garlic; add the purée and simmer 5 minutes.","Slide in paneer cubes and a swirl of cream; warm through.","Serve hot — pairs with rotis or naan."]

meals.name: Sambar
meals.steps_json: ["Pressure-cook dal and rice (separately or stacked) until soft.","Simmer vegetables with tamarind water and sambar powder 10 minutes.","Add the mashed dal and simmer 5 more minutes; temper with curry leaves.","Temper with curry leaves and serve — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Curd Rice with Roasted Peanuts
meals.steps_json: ["Cook the rice soft and let it cool slightly.","Mix in whisked curd and salt.","Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and peanuts in oil; fold through.","Serve at room temperature."]

meals.name: Egg Curry
meals.steps_json: ["Boil, peel, and halve the eggs.","Cook an onion-tomato gravy with ginger-garlic and spices.","Slip the eggs into the gravy and simmer 5 minutes.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Egg Fried Rice
meals.steps_json: ["Cook the rice ahead and cool it (day-old rice is best).","Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.","Stir-fry vegetables on high, add rice and soy sauce, and toss.","Fold in the eggs and spring onion; serve immediately."]

meals.name: Chicken Curry
meals.steps_json: ["Brown onion in oil; add ginger-garlic and tomato and cook to a masala.","Add chicken and spices; sear 5 minutes.","Add a cup of water and simmer 20 minutes until tender.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Chicken Biryani
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate chicken in curd and biryani masala for 30 minutes.","Fry sliced onions in ghee until deep golden; par-boil the rice.","Layer chicken, rice, mint, and fried onions; seal and cook on dum 25 minutes.","Rest 10 minutes before opening; serve with raita."]

meals.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
meals.steps_json: ["Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano.","Grill 4–5 minutes per side; rest, then slice.","Toss greens, tomatoes, and cucumber with olive oil and lemon.","Top with the sliced chicken and serve."]

meals.name: Fish Curry
meals.steps_json: ["Grind coconut with chilli and turmeric into a smooth paste.","Sauté onion and curry leaves; add the paste and tamarind water.","Simmer 5 minutes, then slide in the fish and poach 6–8 minutes.","Serve hot — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Chicken Tikka Wrap
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate chicken strips in curd and tikka masala 15 minutes.","Pan-sear on high until charred and cooked through.","Warm the tortilla; layer chicken, onion, and pepper.","Roll tightly, halve, and serve."]

meals.name: Chicken Keema Matar
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté onion in oil until golden; add tomato and spices.","Add keema and cook 10 minutes, breaking up lumps.","Stir in peas and simmer 5 minutes.","Serve hot — pairs with fresh rotis."]

meals.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
meals.steps_json: ["Rinse dal and rice together.","Temper cumin in ghee; add vegetables and toss.","Add dal, rice, 3 cups water, turmeric, and salt; pressure-cook 3 whistles.","Serve hot with a spoon of ghee on top."]

meals.name: Grilled Paneer Tikka
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate paneer, pepper, and onion chunks in curd, tikka masala, and salt for 15 minutes.","Thread onto skewers or spread on a hot oiled pan.","Char 3–4 minutes per side.","Squeeze lemon over and serve hot."]

meals.name: Vegetable Soup with Paneer
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté garlic in oil; add vegetables and toss 2 minutes.","Add 2 cups water or stock and simmer 10 minutes.","Add paneer cubes; season with salt and pepper.","Simmer 2 more minutes and serve steaming."]

meals.name: Methi Thepla
meals.steps_json: ["Knead atta with chopped methi, turmeric, salt, a spoon of curd, and water.","Rest the dough 15 minutes, then roll thin theplas.","Roast on a tawa with a little oil until spotted golden.","Roast on a tawa until spotted golden — pairs with a bowl of curd."]

meals.name: Tandoori Chicken
meals.steps_json: ["Slash the chicken pieces and marinate in curd, tandoori masala, ginger-garlic, and lemon for 30+ minutes.","Roast in a hot oven or air fryer at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, turning once.","Baste with oil for the last 5 minutes for a char.","Serve with lemon wedges and sliced onion."]

meals.name: Grilled Fish with Vegetables
meals.steps_json: ["Pat the fish dry; rub with olive oil, salt, pepper, and lemon zest.","Grill 3–4 minutes per side until it flakes.","Sauté or grill the vegetables in the same pan.","Plate with a squeeze of lemon."]

meals.name: Chicken Shorba Soup
meals.steps_json: ["Sauté onion and ginger-garlic in oil until fragrant.","Add chicken and 3 cups water; simmer 20 minutes.","Shred the chicken back into the broth; season with pepper and salt.","Finish with coriander and serve hot."]

meals.name: Chicken Stir-fry
meals.steps_json: ["Sear chicken strips in a hot wok; set aside.","Stir-fry garlic, pepper, and broccoli 3 minutes; return the chicken with soy sauce.","Toss on high heat 1 minute and serve — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Whey Protein Shake with Milk
meals.steps_json: ["Add milk, whey, and banana to a blender or shaker.","Blend or shake 20–30 seconds until smooth.","Drink immediately."]

meals.name: Roasted Chana
meals.steps_json: ["Warm the roasted chana in a dry pan for a minute (optional).","Toss with chaat masala and snack away."]

meals.name: Peanut Chaat
meals.steps_json: ["Roast the peanuts in a dry pan until crunchy.","Toss with chopped onion, tomato, and coriander.","Season with chaat masala and lemon juice; serve fresh."]

meals.name: Masala Chaas with Mixed Nuts
meals.steps_json: ["Blend curd with a cup of cold water, salt, and roasted cumin.","Pour into a glass over ice if you like.","Serve with a handful of mixed nuts on the side."]

meals.name: Protein Bar
meals.steps_json: ["Unwrap.","Enjoy between meals — no cooking required."]

meals.name: Spiced Paneer Cubes
meals.steps_json: ["Cube the paneer.","Sear in a lightly oiled pan 2 minutes per side (or eat fresh).","Dust with chaat masala and serve."]

meals.name: Roasted Makhana with Peanuts
meals.steps_json: ["Roast makhana in ghee on low heat until crisp, 6–8 minutes.","Add peanuts for the last 2 minutes.","Season with salt and pepper; cool before serving."]

meals.name: Hummus with Pita
meals.steps_json: ["Blend chickpeas with tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and a splash of cold water until silky.","Season with salt; drizzle olive oil on top.","Warm the pita, cut into wedges, and scoop."]

meals.name: Turmeric Milk
meals.steps_json: ["Warm the milk gently with turmeric, whisking.","Simmer 2 minutes; don't boil over.","Sweeten with honey off the heat and sip warm."]

meals.name: Chicken Tikka Bites
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate bite-size chicken pieces in curd and tikka masala 15 minutes.","Sear in a hot oiled pan until charred and cooked through, 8–10 minutes.","Squeeze lemon over and serve with toothpicks."]

meals.name: Roti (Whole Wheat)
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a soft dough with atta, a pinch of salt, and water; rest 10 minutes.","Roll thin rounds and roast on a hot tawa until puffed and spotted.","Finish with a light smear of ghee and serve hot."]

meals.name: Steamed Rice
meals.steps_json: ["Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.","Cook with 2x water (pot or cooker) until tender, about 15 minutes.","Rest 5 minutes, fluff, and serve."]

meals.name: Butter Naan
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a soft dough with maida, curd, a pinch of salt and sugar; rest 1 hour.","Roll teardrops and cook on a very hot tawa until blistered.","Brush with butter and serve hot."]

meals.name: Curd (Dahi)
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk the curd until smooth.","Serve chilled, plain or with a pinch of salt."]

meals.name: Cucumber Raita
meals.steps_json: ["Whisk curd smooth with a splash of water.","Stir in grated cucumber, roasted cumin, and salt.","Chill and serve."]

meals.name: Kachumber Salad
meals.steps_json: ["Dice onion, tomato, and cucumber evenly.","Toss with lemon juice and salt just before serving."]

meals.name: Masala Dosa
meals.steps_json: ["Boil and crumble the potatoes; temper mustard, curry leaves, onion, and turmeric, then toss the potato through.","Spread a ladle of dosa batter thin on a hot oiled tawa.","Crisp 2 minutes, spoon the masala down the middle, and fold.","Serve hot — pairs with sambar and chutney."]

meals.name: Rasam
meals.steps_json: ["Crush tomatoes with garlic; simmer with tamarind water and rasam powder 10 minutes.","Temper mustard and curry leaves in ghee; pour over.","Serve steaming — pairs with steamed rice."]

meals.name: Lemon Rice with Peanuts
meals.steps_json: ["Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.","Temper mustard, curry leaves, peanuts, and turmeric in oil.","Toss the rice through with salt and plenty of lemon juice.","Serve warm or at room temperature."]

meals.name: Puliogare (Tamarind Rice)
meals.steps_json: ["Cook the rice and spread it to cool.","Simmer thick tamarind pulp with puliogare powder into a paste.","Temper peanuts and curry leaves in oil; fold paste and rice together.","Rest 10 minutes for the flavors to soak, then serve."]

meals.name: Aloo Tikki
meals.steps_json: ["Boil, mash, and season the potatoes with chilli, coriander, and salt.","Bind with cornflour and shape into patties.","Shallow-fry until deeply golden on both sides.","Dust with chaat masala and serve hot."]

meals.name: Soya Chaap Tikka
meals.steps_json: ["Marinate chaap pieces in curd, tandoori masala, and ginger-garlic 20 minutes.","Roast in a hot pan or air fryer, basting with oil, until charred.","Squeeze lemon over and serve hot."]

meals.name: Sambar (Side)
meals.steps_json: ["Pressure-cook toor dal until soft; mash.","Simmer with vegetables, tamarind water, and sambar powder 10 minutes.","Temper with curry leaves and serve hot."]

meals.name: Poori
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a stiff dough with atta, salt, and water; rest 15 minutes.","Roll small discs and deep-fry in hot oil until puffed and golden.","Drain and serve immediately."]

meals.name: Bhatura
meals.steps_json: ["Knead a soft dough with maida, curd, a pinch of baking soda and salt; rest 2 hours.","Roll ovals and deep-fry in hot oil, ladling oil over until ballooned.","Serve hot — classic with chole."]
